workloads.root_ns: 1M calls of a trivial fn, each its own root span (worst case)
workloads.nested_ns: 1M calls of a trivial fn inside one root span
workloads.store_ns: 200k point-read-like calls (2 spans each: get -> checksum), ~hundreds of ns of work

unit: ns per call of the workload (store_ms: total milliseconds)
